summary: Independent SG-10 re-review approves TASK-0041. The prior changes_requested findings are addressed: verification-summary internal SHA claims now match current scorecards and goal-inspect summary, unavailable provider token/cost usage is null and recorded per run, Mode A remains 5/5 successful with hard metrics zero, invalid Planner raw/driver output evidence remains preserved, and Mode C remains no-go.

criteria.criterion: Real Planner prompt/output contract explicitly names the required PlanDraft fields used by the compiler.
criteria.notes: PlanDraft prompt/output contract explicitly names compiler-required fields and rejects TASK-0040 alias shapes; tests and corrected verification summary support this.

criteria.criterion: Planner output is still admitted or rejected before any execution.
criteria.notes: Every Mode A run has planner-admission-report.json and execution occurs only after admission passed.

criteria.criterion: Any adapter normalization is deterministic, minimal, documented and covered by tests; it must not weaken Goal, Claim, Gate, Runtime or capability boundaries.
criteria.notes: Normalization/reporting changes are deterministic and bounded; allowedCapabilities are input context only and PlanIR capability boundaries remain enforced.

criteria.criterion: Invalid raw Planner output and parsed driver output remain preserved as artifacts with digests.
criteria.notes: TASK-0040 invalid raw and parsed Planner outputs remain indexed with matching SHA-256 digests; invalid-output preservation path is covered by tests.

criteria.criterion: At least five post-change Mode A repetitions are executed, or a setup blocker is classified without weakening criteria.
criteria.notes: Post-change Mode A scorecard records five repetitions.

criteria.criterion: At least one Mode A run produces an admitted PlanDraft, or the report identifies a narrower reproducible model/adapter blocker than TASK-0040.
criteria.notes: All five Mode A runs produced admitted PlanDrafts and succeeded.

criteria.criterion: Hard safety metrics remain zero for false completion, unrun gate pass, unadmitted node execution, stale fencing accept and duplicate resume effect.
criteria.notes: Hard safety metrics are zero/no violation and inspect summaries report missingArtifactCount=0.

criteria.criterion: Token, cost, latency, plan size and rejection/admission metrics are recorded per run when available; unavailable provider usage is recorded as null, not fabricated.
criteria.notes: Provider usage is now represented as null when unavailable and recorded per run; internal SHA claims match current file bytes.

criteria.criterion: Final report distinguishes model contract adherence from kernel defects.
criteria.notes: Reports distinguish Planner contract adherence from kernel defects and keep Mode C no-go.

criteria.criterion: Independent verifier approves the TASK-0041 report before completion.
criteria.notes: Independent re-review approves TASK-0041 after the previous metrics/SHA findings were corrected.
